localBiteReport: Reports from early October 2026 on the Choctawhatchee Bay show the fall inshore bite picking up nicely. A Fort Walton Beach guide reported one week ago that redfish and trout were heating up in the bayous, aligning with the broader fall pattern local guides describe as one of the best of the year for bull reds and speckled trout on the flats. A Santa Rosa Beach guide also noted around the same time that all fish seem to be firing, echoing the seasonal shift. Water temperature is 83°F. The most recent Half Hitch Destin report on record is dated September 28, 2026 — roughly 10 days old — and its full bay-fishing content was not directly accessible, but the broader pattern from that outlet and captainexperiences.com guides is consistent: redfish active in bayous and along structure, speckled trout moving around, and flounder improving as fall progresses toward its peak gigging months.
